fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for the bug where ship-change's landed-green failed on pending CI (nebari PR #83). The planner found the cause: rhiza run resume --retry restarts a failed run at the failed command step (landed-green), skipping the wait step (wait-landed) that polls until checks settle. The change set was placed under m27-nebari-on-rhiza, like the plan-flake fix. One question (how a retry should wait for CI: a retry_at field, an engine rule inferring the wait, or green steps that poll) went to the arbiter, who decided retry-reopens-at-the-wait: a generic engine rule that reopens a retry at the wait step whose on.pass is the failed step. No owner words: the run was autonomous.
fields.title: Landed-green retry plan, autonomous
